material.acceptance_criteria: SIZE names the rule (for example SIZE.own for own non-hero units, SIZE.hero only for heroes), and each constant changes only the units it names.
material.description: ui_minimap.js:22-24 sizeFor returns SIZE.hero when own || hero, so an own creep (not a hero) draws at hero size. paint marks own at ui_minimap.js:123 and passes it to sizeFor at :125. A maintainer who retunes SIZE.hero to change hero dots also resizes own creeps. The name SIZE.hero does not reveal the rule (own units are emphasised). dotSize (ui_minimap.js:26-28) is exported with no caller.

notes.note: Triage keep. Located: ui_minimap.js:22-24 sizeFor returns SIZE.hero for own || hero; paint passes own at :123 and sizes at :125. Observable: own non-hero creeps draw at 5 px, the hero size (SIZE.creep is 3 px, :8). Retuning SIZE.hero resizes own creeps as well. Read: ui_minimap.js 1-205 dispatch 1792859429070-6387-47df82884af9e433.

material.subject: The SIZE.hero dot size is applied to own non-hero units, so the name says the opposite of the rule
material.witness: Live Chrome, session verify-CLEANNAME-trav-minimap-camera-1, real module at sha 8d102946 (ui_minimap.js on raw.githubusercontent). With SIZE.hero edited to 12 in that source, own hero dot draws 12 and own non-hero creep (id 2) stays 5 (SIZE.own). Parent 834d8d31 control with SIZE.hero 9 (dispatch 1792862... not captured; earlier control on 1ed26ddd showed own creep 9) reproduced the fault. CI: ci workflow success on 8d102946 (run 40116212358).
material.witness_plan: Read sizeFor and paint: after the fix, the constant that sizes own non-hero units is not SIZE.hero, and changing SIZE.hero moves hero dots only.
